rationale: MGNI gapped up ~13% on strong earnings beats and is trading at 72% of its intraday range with the last five 1-minute candles showing a stalling/slight fade pattern (high of $28.17 already set, now consolidating around $27.38-27.54) — no clean directional setup is present.
